description: The limiter as a device: an input gain, a ceiling and a release, its models (the browser's clean compressor and a clip, or the lookahead brickwall limiter of @audio/dynamics-limiter with its look-ahead and true peak), the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the curve a state plays and the source of the look-ahead model's worklet, with no panel and no audio in it.
name: limiter-device
